endorsements.name: Catherine J. Ullman
endorsements.label: EHLO is that really you?
endorsements.description: The eerie glow of the monitor pierced the shadows of her room. Heart racing with indecision, she stared intensely at the blinking cursor. Should she reply? Just delete? As attackers become more clever, determining the legitimacy of email messages can be a real challenge. Join investigatorchic as she walks us through examining the attackers fingerprints both to establish the message’s origin and report the attacker before they strike again!
